score = 101
if score >= 0 OR score <= 100 then
    print("Valid")

p: Explain your predicted result using the first assignment or test.
Extend with an ELSE that prints Invalid.
code_first.a: Original prints Valid; corrected condition does not; ELSE prints Invalid.

original_exam_questions: Differentiate a syntax error from a logic error. [2 marks]
Syntax violates language rules; logic produces incorrect behaviour even if program runs.
Identify the fault in if age >= 13 OR age <= 18 for acceptance age 13–18. [2 marks]
Use AND, not OR; OR incorrectly accepts values outside the range.
Explain why testing after debugging is necessary. [2 marks]
To verify the correction and ensure no new faults were introduced.

optional_original_challenge.coreHint: With OR, one side can be true even when the number is outside the range.

stretch.task: Correct the code with AND and add an ELSE. Test -1, 0, 100 and 101.
stretch.hint: An acceptable mark must pass both comparisons.

mastery.task: Find a second error in an age checker that says IF age >= 13 AND age < 18 even though 18 is valid. Repair both the logic and the upper boundary, then write four tests.
mastery.hint: Pay attention to AND/OR and inclusive/exclusive symbols.
mastery.answer: Correct condition age>=13 AND age<=18. Tests 12 invalid,13 valid,18 valid,19 invalid. Explain why <18 incorrectly rejects the upper boundary.
